item.description:
Notex 0.2.9
Clearer meeting summaries and smoother long transcripts Auto summaries from OpenRouter now favor a shorter overview, distinct topics, and agreed follow-ups, including commitments made across two speakers' turns. Opening a note and switching to a long transcript avoid repeated transcript preparation and unnecessary text styling.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.8
More faithful OpenRouter action items Auto meeting summaries using OpenRouter now ask the model to support each action item with a source excerpt. This helps keep existing routines, questions, and unapproved ideas out of the action list while retaining agreed follow-ups.
Requires macOS 26 or later.

Notex 0.2.7
OpenRouter on managed networks OpenRouter summaries and note chat now connect through Notex. If your organization allows Notex's connection but blocks direct requests to model providers, you can use your own OpenRouter API key. OpenRouter bills inference to your key.
Choose models for summaries and chat Select an OpenRouter model separately for meeting summaries and note chat in Settings → AI Connections. Each feature also offers Auto, On Device, and OpenRouter processing choices. Model choices persist across launches, and compact menus show readable model names.
Clearer summary sections Generated meeting summaries have more space between section headings. Topic sections focus on context and findings instead of repeating decisions, action items, or open questions.
Cleaner recording options The transcript sidebar's options menu uses a compact borderless control.
Requires macOS 26 or later.
